| $f$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=3$ | $Y=5$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=2$ | $\frac{5}{27}$ | $\frac{2}{9}$ | $\frac{1}{9}$ |
| $X=4$ | $\frac{1}{9}$ | $\frac{8}{27}$ | $\frac{2}{27}$ |

Compute ${f}_{Y|X}(3\,|\,4)$ given that the discrete random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
feedback.worked_solution:
The conditional probability mass function ${f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)$ is defined as

$$
{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)=P(Y=y\,|\,X=x).
$$

Therefore, we're required to compute the conditional probability

$$
{f}_{Y|X}(3\,|\,4)=P(Y=3\,|\,X=4).
$$

By the multiplication law for conditional probability, we have

$$
P(Y=3\,|\,X=4)=\frac{P(X=4,Y=3)}{P(X=4)}=\frac{f(4,3)}{{f}_{X}(4)}
$$

where $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability mass function of $X$ and $Y,$ and ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal distribution of $X.$

Recall that the marginal distribution for $X$ corresponds to the row totals. Thus, 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{X}(4) & =f(4,1)+f(4,3)+f(4,5) \\  & =\frac{1}{9}+\frac{8}{27}+\frac{2}{27} \\  & =\frac{13}{27}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the given table, $f(4,3)=\frac{8}{27}.$ 

Finally, substituting  ${f}_{X}(4)=\frac{13}{27}$ and $f(4,3)=\frac{8}{27}$ in our formula above, we obtain 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y|X}(3\,|\,4) & =P(Y=3\,|\,X=4) \\  & =\frac{f(4,3)}{{f}_{X}(4)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{8}{27})}{(\frac{13}{27})} \\  & =\frac{8}{13}.\end{aligned}
$$
